overview_description.description:
Litify helps law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its fully AI-native platform of action. The industry-leading solution combines trusted cloud-based technology, configurable, AI-powered workflows, and powerful business analytics. 

By integrating next-generation AI actions and insights across the platform, Litify offers a future-ready solution that enhances strategic decision-making, increases client satisfaction, and enables every teammate to operate at their full potential.

Additional capabilities include matter and intake management, document generation, timekeeping and billing, legal hold and corporate eBilling, mobile, and more.

about_short_description.short_description: Litify helps law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its fully AI-native platform of action.

product.name: Litify Platform
product.description: A cloud-based legal operations platform for law firms and corporate legal departments, combining intake, matter, document, time, billing, spend, workflow, and reporting capabilities.

product.name: Litify AI
product.description: Embedded legal artificial intelligence that analyzes matter data and documents, drafts content, summarizes information, identifies risks, and automates workflows within Litify.

product.name: Litify Enterprise Legal Management
product.description: A legal management solution for corporate legal departments to centralize matters, documents, requests, outside counsel collaboration, legal holds, eBilling, spend, and performance reporting.

product.name: Litify Plaintiff Practice Management
product.description: A case management solution for personal injury firms that manages intake, client relationships, matters, documents, medical information, settlements, payments, and operational reporting.

product.name: Litify Insurance Defense Case Management
product.description: A case management and billing solution for insurance defense firms that centralizes matters, automates time capture, applies billing rules, manages invoices, and reports on performance.

product.name: Litify Immigration Case Management
product.description: A case management solution for consumer and corporate immigration firms that standardizes intake, forms, documents, deadlines, client communication, payments, billing, and reporting.
